budgetManager.title: Production Budget Manager

animatic_first.name: Animatic First
animatic_first.hint: Pre-vis frames only. Validate in Screening Room before spending video credits.

draft_production.name: Draft Production
draft_production.hint: Draft frames and video with checkpointed scene review.

final_delivery.name: Final Delivery
final_delivery.hint: Final resolution frames and video, with Topaz planned for polish.

express_sprint.name: Express Sprint
express_sprint.hint: Concurrent batch path. Higher iteration contingency — script changes after batch are costly.

suggestions.useAnimaticFirst: Switch to Animatic First and confirm the story in Screening Room before generating video.
suggestions.stayOnDraft: Stay on Draft resolution until Screening Room sign-off, then upgrade to Final.
suggestions.lowerFrameIterations: Lower frame iterations toward the 80% first-take default (1.25×).
suggestions.lowerVideoIterations: Lower video iterations toward the 90% first-take default (~1.11×).
suggestions.disableTopaz: Turn off Topaz until Final Delivery — upscale after you lock picture.
suggestions.enableByok: Enable BYOK planning exclusion if you will pay image/video providers directly.

script.heading: Scene heading
script.noScriptHint: Generate a script from your approved blueprint to start production.

language.languageHint: Dialogue and narration are generated in this language. Frame and video prompts stay in English.

prompts.englishOnlyNotice: Prompts stay in English: image and video models produce noticeably weaker results from translated prompts.

express.title: Express All Scenes (advanced)
express.description: Runs Direction → Audio → pre-vis frames for every scene in parallel (up to 3 at a time). This is a long, credit-heavy run — per-scene Express on each scene card is recommended for checkpoints.
express.audioLanguageHint: Dialogue and narration will be generated in {lang}. Existing audio in other languages is left untouched.
express.storyboardQualityDraftHint: Generates fast layout frames for review. Use Finalize frames afterward for hi-res photorealistic animatic and video generation.
express.soundEffectsHint: Sound effects are included in Veo video segments during production. Animatic preview uses narration, dialogue, and optional music only.
express.onlyMissingFramesHint: Skip frames that already have images.
express.regenerateExistingHint: Recompute every phase even if direction, audio, or image is already present.
express.artStyleLockedHint: Locked in Blueprint — change foundation there to reimagine.
express.artStyleUnlockedHint: Applied to all pre-vis frames and flows through video generation.
express.costEstimateDisclaimer: Estimates only. Actual usage depends on dialogue length and the number of phases that actually need to run.

expressAudio.title: Express Audio
expressAudio.description: Generate dialogue, sound effects, and music for this scene concurrently. Dialogue uses TTS, action beats use Veo native audio, and music uses Lyria.
expressAudio.scopeAllWarning: Existing audio for the selected items will be deleted and regenerated.
expressAudio.noAudioItems: No audio items available for this scene.

expressSfx.title: Express Veo SFX
expressSfx.description: Generate action-beat sound effects concurrently (up to 2 at a time). Each beat uses Veo native audio, then extracts MP3 for the animatic.
expressSfx.regenerateWithAudio: Regenerate beats that already have audio

expressScene.title: Express Scene
expressScene.description: Choose which pre-vis frames to generate or regenerate. Regenerating existing frames updates images only — direction and audio are left unchanged.
expressScene.scopeRegenerateHint: Checked frames with existing images will be regenerated. Direction and audio are not rerun.
expressScene.noFrames: No frames available for this scope.
expressScene.imageCredits: Image credits (est.): {credits} ({count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} × {perFrame})

expressGenerateAll.title: Generate All
expressGenerateAll.description: Run Express Audio and Express Scene frames in parallel. Defaults match each pipeline’s “missing only” selection — adjust scope if you need to regenerate.
expressGenerateAll.noAudioItems: No audio items for this scene.
expressGenerateAll.imageCredits: Image credits (est.): {credits} ({count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} × {perFrame})
